name: medmal-oh
title: Ohio medical professional liability rating
summary: Rate Ohio physicians and surgeons from two insurers' filed manuals: classes, territories, limits, claims-made and occurrence rates, tail coverage, credits, schedule rating, full premiums and one doctor at both insurers.
description: Each task gives the AI the filed rating manuals, rate pages and exhibits of two insurers' medical professional liability programs in Ohio, and states the facts in the question, such as a physician's specialty, county and limits. It asks for exact values: a premium, a factor, a credit, a rule, a territory, or the errors in the documents themselves. Every field of the answer is checked, and a task passes only when all of them are right.

upstream.name: Ohio Department of Insurance, public filing records
upstream.by: the filers, through the Ohio Department of Insurance

families.name: Full premium
families.what: The whole rating at either insurer, through the specialty rate, limits, credits and caps, up to the final premium.

families.name: Class lookup
families.what: The right specialty class, code and rate, with other health professionals included.

families.name: Territory
families.what: Each insurer's territory for a county, where the two group counties differently.

families.name: Limits factor
families.what: The factor for a limit the table lists, and what the manual says for one it does not.

families.name: Claims-made and occurrence
families.what: The claims-made year from a retroactive date, and each insurer's occurrence rate.

families.name: Tail coverage
families.what: Extended reporting period premiums, and when the tail is free on retirement or death.

families.name: Practice credits
families.what: Part-time, new to practice, training and leave of absence credits, and which of them combine.

families.name: Premium modifications
families.what: Claims-free, deductible, corporation and exposure credits and charges, held to the cap on total credits.

families.name: Schedule rating
families.what: Schedule credits and debits held to their limits, with Ohio's limits in place of the countrywide plan's.

families.name: Both insurers side by side
families.what: The same physician rated at both insurers, each under its own rules.

families.name: Checking the documents
families.what: The filings' own errors, told apart from passages that only look wrong.
